caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, metallic plate or shallow bowl with an ornate handle at the top. The main body of the object is circular, with concentric circles visible on the inner surface, suggesting a shallow depth. The plate is shaded in gray tones to convey a metallic appearance and depth. At the top of the plate, there is a decorative handle consisting of one large circular loop at the center, flanked by two internal, symmetrical cut-out shapes and surmounted by a small rounded top, which appears to be a solid extension of the rim. The entire object is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular frame on a beige or off-white background. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller, technical side view of the object showing dimensions: the diameter is labeled as 6 3/4 inches and the depth as 7/8 inch. The drawing uses fine lines and careful shading throughout, and the artist's signature “GRUBSCHMIT” appears at the bottom right corner of the main rectangular frame.
title: Silver Porringer
